source_title: Who Is Late ‘Star Trek’ Actor Patrick Stewart’s Wife? All About Sunny Ozell - People.com
source_excerpt:
‘X-Men’ star Patrick Stewart, who died on Oct. 28, was married to Sunny Ozell for over a decade
Patrick Stewart met his wife, Sunny Ozell, in 2008
The Star Trek and X-Men actor, who died on Oct. 28, and Ozell got married in September 2013
Sunny Ozell was “ so proud ” to be Patrick Stewart ’s wife.
The late Star Trek actor met musician Sunny Ozell in 2008 at a restaurant in New York City, where she was working as a waitress at the time. After several years of dating, they got married on Sept. 7, 2013. Stewart was previously married to Sheila Falconer, with whom he welcomed two children, and Wendy Neuss.
In March 2022, Stewart spoke to PEOPLE about how his wife keeps him on his toes.
“I’ve never met anyone like her before,” he said. “She is so smart and so informed. And her intellectual accomplishments are extraordinary. She remembers everything.”
On Oct. 29, a spokesperson for Stewart confirmed his death at 86 in a statement, sharing that he died one day earlier “in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny, following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.”
“He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter, and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all,” the statement continued.
So, who is Patrick Stewart’s wife? Here’s everything to know about Sunny Ozell and her relationship with the late actor.
While Stewart built his career in film and television, Ozell is a successful singer and songwriter who has released two studio albums.
Her debut album, Take It with Me , was released in 2015, and her second album, titled Overnight Lows , followed five years later.
She met Stewart in 2008 while working as a waitress
Ozell met Stewart in 2008 while she was working as a waitress at the now-closed Franny’s Restaurant in N.Y.C. At the time, Stewart was performing in a production of Macbeth at the nearby Brooklyn Academy of Music.
“She was working as a waitress in a restaurant in Brooklyn,” he recalled to PEOPLE in 2022. “This lovely woman came over and said, ‘Gentleman, on the house, what would you like for desserts?’ We got talking and she told me how much she’d wanted to see Macbeth , but it had been sold out. The Brooklyn run, which was only three or four weeks, sold out before we opened.”
Stewart went on to explain that he had given Ozell his phone number — the only time in his life that he had given someone his number — so he could arrange tickets to the show for her.
“[I] said ‘Call me, I can get a ticket.’ And that’s what we did. And she came backstage afterward and we had dinner and here we are,” he said.
The couple wed on Sept. 7, 2013, in Ozell’s home state of Nevada. Stewart’s longtime friend and X-Men costar Ian McKellen officiated the ceremony; however, the pair faced a wedding mishap after they learned that McKellen’s ordination credentials weren’t accepted in Nevada.
During a March 2020 appearance on Jimmy Kimmel Live! , Stewart admitted to guest host Pete Buttigieg that following the Nevada ceremony, they held a last-minute wedding at a Los Angeles Mexican restaurant, which McKellen also officiated.
In honor of their 11th anniversary in September 2024, Stewart shared a sweet selfie on Instagram , writing, “You make everything better and brighter, my love.”
She informed Stewart about his 2016 Golden Globe nomination
When Stewart was nominated for a Golden Globe in 2016 for his performance in Blunt Talk , Ozell happened to spot the news first — and reacted by letting out a shriek (which was actually a yell of joy).
“I’m on vacation in Jamaica, and I was up early this morning reading The Guardian newspaper on my iPad, and I’m thinking that the announcements are not going to be made for another two hours when suddenly I heard this howl from the bedroom where my wife, I thought, was sleeping,” Stewart told PEOPLE at the time.
The actor said he “rushed in” thinking a spider had climbed into bed with her, but “no, she was already online looking at the announcements and the nominations.”
“First of all, I was reassured she wasn’t being eaten by something — and she had this wonderful news that I wasn’t expecting, if it came at all, for another two hours so it was a very nice start to my day,” Stewart said.
In addition to sharing a life together, the couple have also shared the screen together. Ozell made an appearance in a season 2 episode of Star Trek: Picard .
In the episode, which aired on Apr. 14, 2022, Ozell briefly appeared on stage with her real-life band during one of the show’s most dramatic scenes. She can be seen performing the song “Take You Down,” which is featured on her 2020 album Overnight Lows .
